SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * $eur_to_usd
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * $jpy_to_usd
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            CASE o.currency
                WHEN 'EUR' THEN (o.amount_minor / 100.0) * $eur_to_usd
                WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * $jpy_to_usd
            END
        ),
        0
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE o.currency = 'EUR'), 0) / 100.0
        AS gross_revenue_eur,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE o.currency = 'JPY'), 0)
        AS gross_revenue_jpy,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS gross_revenue_usd,
    'USD revenue cannot be calculated without EUR/USD and JPY/USD exchange rates and a conversion-date policy.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

WITH refund_totals AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
),
exchange_rates AS (
    SELECT
        'EUR' AS currency,
        100 AS minor_units_per_unit,
        CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)) AS usd_per_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'JPY',
        1,
        CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                (o.amount_minor - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0))
                / fx.minor_units_per_unit
                * fx.usd_per_unit
            ),
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN exchange_rates AS fx ON fx.currency = o.currency
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    SELECT 'EUR' AS currency, 100.0 AS minor_units_per_unit,
           CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)) AS usd_per_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'JPY', 1.0,
           CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
),
revenue_movements AS (
    SELECT o.currency, o.amount_minor AS net_amount_minor
    FROM eligible_orders AS o
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT o.currency, -r.amount_minor AS net_amount_minor
    FROM refunds AS r
    JOIN eligible_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(
        m.net_amount_minor / x.minor_units_per_unit * x.usd_per_unit
    ), 0),
    2
) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM revenue_movements AS m
JOIN exchange_rates AS x ON x.currency = m.currency;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    SELECT 'EUR' AS currency,
           CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)) AS usd_per_major_unit,
           0.01 AS major_units_per_minor_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'JPY',
           CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)),
           1.00
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
),
april_movements AS (
    SELECT currency, amount_minor AS net_amount_minor
    FROM eligible_orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT o.currency, -r.amount_minor AS net_amount_minor
    FROM refunds AS r
    JOIN eligible_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            m.net_amount_minor
            * e.major_units_per_minor_unit
            * e.usd_per_major_unit
        ),
        0
    ),
    2
) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM april_movements AS m
JOIN exchange_rates AS e ON e.currency = m.currency;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    SELECT 'EUR' AS currency, 100.0 AS minor_units_per_unit,
           CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)) AS usd_per_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'JPY', 1.0, CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
),
may_activity AS (
    SELECT currency, amount_minor AS net_amount_minor
    FROM eligible_orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT o.currency, -r.amount_minor AS net_amount_minor
    FROM refunds AS r
    JOIN eligible_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(a.net_amount_minor / e.minor_units_per_unit * e.usd_per_unit), 0),
    2
) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM may_activity AS a
JOIN exchange_rates AS e ON e.currency = a.currency;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    SELECT 'EUR' AS currency, 100.0 AS minor_units_per_unit,
           CAST($eur_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8)) AS usd_per_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'JPY', 1.0,
           CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 8))
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            (o.amount_minor - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0))
            / fx.minor_units_per_unit
            * fx.usd_per_unit
        ),
        0
    ),
    2
) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN exchange_rates AS fx ON fx.currency = o.currency
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT c.is_internal;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT

SELECT
    SUM(
        CAST(oi.qty AS DECIMAL(18, 0)) * oi.unit_price_minor
        * CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN $eur_to_usd / 100.0
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd
          END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'apparel'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(oi.qty::HUGEINT * oi.unit_price_minor)
            FILTER (WHERE o.currency = 'EUR'),
        0
    ) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_eur,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(oi.qty::HUGEINT * oi.unit_price_minor)
            FILTER (WHERE o.currency = 'JPY'),
        0
    ) AS gross_revenue_jpy,
    NULL::DECIMAL(38, 2) AS gross_revenue_usd,
    'USD revenue cannot be calculated without EUR-to-USD and JPY-to-USD exchange rates.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'electronics'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
    SUM(
        oi.qty::DOUBLE * oi.unit_price_minor
        * CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN CAST($eur_to_usd AS DOUBLE) / 100.0
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DOUBLE)

    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'home'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')

SELECT

                WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd
              END
        ),
        0
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd

JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'outdoors'

SELECT

JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'garden'

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM refunds r
            WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id
        ) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
    ) AS refunded_apparel_order_share
FROM orders o
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
      AND LOWER(p.category) = 'apparel'
);

SELECT

FROM orders o
WHERE EXISTS (

WITH january_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share
FROM january_customers;

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1) * 1.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share_with_multiple_orders
FROM customer_order_counts;

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS repeat_customer_share
FROM customer_order_counts;

WITH customer_order_counts AS (

    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1) AS DOUBLE)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share_with_more_than_one_order
FROM customer_order_counts;

SELECT
